reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Global Surgical Package and Related Modifiers (24, 54, 55, 56, 57, 58, 76, 77, 78, and 79)
reimbursement_policies.evidence: No DRG-specific authorization or mapping rule is stated for this DRG. The policy instead governs global surgical package reimbursement and modifier handling on surgical claims.

Modifier 54 is used for surgical care only when one provider performs the surgery and another provides preoperative and/or postoperative management. It is valid only for surgical procedure codes with a 10- or 90-day global period.

General claims-editing policy; no DRG-specific mapping or classification-shift rule is stated. Payment remains subject to eligibility, benefits, referral/authorization, and claims-editing logic.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Split Surgical Package Policy, Professional - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
Hospital Inclusive Charges Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: This policy is a general facility inclusive-charges rule, not a DRG-specific rule. Routine room, board, facility, surgical-room, and nursing services are bundled into the inpatient or outpatient facility charge and are not separately reimbursable. Facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management is reimbursable at one unit per day, while routine components remain bundled.

utilization_limits: 1 unit/day for ventilator or CPAP management
exemptions: management of a Ventilator or CPAP, owned by the facility
certain ancillary services ancillary to the Ventilator or CPAP usage

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Add or validate a facility bundle edit for CA cesarean UB04 claims so routine ancillary lines under revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-370, 410, and 412 are treated as inclusive rather than separate auth-sensitive services, while preserving the United Health limit of 1 unit/day for ventilator or CPAP management and the exemption for management of a Ventilator or CPAP, owned by the facility. Apply to CA. Exempt: management of a Ventilator or CPAP, owned by the facility, certain ancillary services ancillary to the Ventilator or CPAP usage.

IA — Before changing CA cesarean authorization classification, audit split-surgical-care mapping for modifiers 54, 55, and 56, including exclusion handling for 54 and 55, and only allow the split-care scenario when the claim pairs on the same date of service and same surgical procedure code with transfer of postoperative care, after first postoperative visit, or before surgery; also confirm provider-role routing is limited to the surgeon relinquishing postop care and the receiving physician, not assistant surgeon. (CA)
